.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml.summary: This file configures GitHub issue templates for the project by disabling blank issues and providing external contact links to guides, discussions, and support.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml.summary: This file defines the GitHub issue template for reporting bugs, guiding users to check prerequisites and provide debug logs. It standardizes bug submissions for the project.

.github/FUNDING.yml.summary: This file configures financial sponsorship platforms for the project. It integrates funding options like GitHub and Ko-fi to support the repository's maintenance.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.summary: This GitHub Actions workflow automates the continuous integration pipeline by running type checks, tests, and builds on Node.js 20. It ensures code quality for pushes and pull requests targeting the `main` branch.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.y.summary: This YAML configuration file defines the GitHub issue template for feature requests, guiding users to provide structured proposals. It standardizes enhancement submissions across the project repository.

.github/workflows/issue-triage.yml.summary: This GitHub Actions workflow automates issue categorization and labeling upon creation, reopening, or via `/triage` commands, serving as the automated issue management pipeline for the project.

.github/workflows/republish-version.yml.summary: This manually triggered GitHub Actions workflow validates the requested version against `package.json` and optionally unpublishes the existing npm release before republishing. It automates version republishing; it exports no functions or classes.

.github/workflows/release.yml.summary: This GitHub Actions workflow automates releases on pushes to `main` or manual dispatch, checking that the package version is stable and changed before publishing. It has no exported functions or classes.

.github/workflows/release-beta.yml.summary: This GitHub Actions workflow manually prepares a beta release, verifies it is not running on `main`, and determines the next beta version. It automates the project’s beta publishing process; it exports no functions or classes.

AGENTS.MD.summary: `AGENTS.md` provides AI agent developer guidelines, outlining repository architecture, build/test commands, and TypeScript coding standards.

CHANGELOG.md.summary: `CHANGELOG.md` records project version history, feature additions, and model updates. It documents project evolution and changes without exporting any code symbols.
